provenance.provenance_note: 預留協作、共享、影響與來源欄位；目前系統以單一個人語言系統為基準。

governance.shared_principle_rule: LOC provides common governance and classification principles. LunaRunes, lo3rwang and other governed Scopes may use the same principles while keeping separate subjects, data, authority and history.
governance.scope_separation_rule: LOC Governance may summarize scopes and provide cross-scope history lookup. LunaRunes Governance owns rune-specific authority and history. lo3rwang Governance owns personal identity, Zhengde Style, works, keywords, personal ERA and history. Cross-scope visibility does not transfer ownership.
governance.progressive_disclosure_rule: Users do not need to understand the entire LOC framework, all LunaRunes or the author's complete corpus before using the system. They may enter through any relevant Feature and progressively open deeper context, governance and history only when interested.
governance.system_vs_personal: LOC system governance defines representation, authority, boundary and lifecycle; Zhengde Style/self-governance remains a personal governance corpus and example, not a mandatory worldview.
governance.stance: share methods and language without requiring belief or obedience

loc.definition: 把語言整理成可理解、可搜尋、可推演的模型結構。

naming_canon.rule: Luna Codex 不得作為月之符文的英文名稱；月之符文的正式英文名稱固定為 LunaRunes。

current_architecture.formula: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition
current_architecture.authority_flow: Current Canon → Scope Model → Feature Model → Page Composition → UI/Search/RAG/Analysis
current_architecture.scope_rule: Scope is the governed data/authority boundary of an instance. Scopes are mutable and instance-specific; this registry does not define a permanent universal scope list.
current_architecture.feature_rule: Features are reusable capabilities that consume a Scope without taking ownership of it. Features are also valid user entry points and do not require prior knowledge of the whole Scope.
current_architecture.page_rule: Pages compose a Scope with Features. Page/UI/Search/RAG projections do not create Canon authority.
current_architecture.historical_rule: Historical records may explain provenance, rationale and lineage, but cannot override Current authority. Historical data itself is not contamination; contamination occurs only when historical semantics are promoted into Current authority.
current_architecture.nav_rule: NAV is a governed mutable Page Composition interface. Current canonical domain identity has priority over compatibility paths.

lunarunes_feature_concepts.符文籤詩: 抽牌、籤詩與解牌能力；屬可重用 Feature，不是 Current 架構層級。
lunarunes_feature_concepts.符文脈絡: 符文之間或符文與事件／作品之間的關係、情境與 Graph 能力。
lunarunes_feature_concepts.符文體系: 符文本體及其文學、歌曲、影像、沙盒與方法論分析等延伸形式；月之符文是種子，但不是使用門檻。
lunarunes_feature_concepts.符文演算: 可重複規則：抽牌／解牌 Grammar，以及以 Current 九群組作為座標的文字／來源分析。九群組名稱與成員只讀 data/json/core/runes66groups.json。
lunarunes_feature_concepts.符文文化: 把符文、作品、語言與治理放回時間中觀察其形成、變化與文化脈絡。

fixed_constants.reference_rune: 0 德（De）：作者／月語者誌銘與治理錨點；不參與抽牌、無卡面

historical_provenance.loc1_8_rule: LOC1–8 may remain only as historical identifiers and source-lineage metadata. They do not define Current information architecture, Scope boundaries, Feature ownership, navigation taxonomy, registry authority or Current file naming.
historical_provenance.legacy_domain_rule: Older runes/context/music/literary/media/governance/knowledge/evolution domain labels may remain as historical routing metadata but are not the Current architecture model.

model_principles: Current Canon 是唯一現行權威；下游 UI、Search、RAG、Generated data、舊 FAQ、舊 README 與歷史文件不得反向覆寫。
LOC 是框架與分類工具；LunaRunes、lo3rwang 與其他 Scope 主體不同，但可共用相同治理原則。
Current 架構固定採 Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition。
使用者不需先理解全 LOC、全部 LunaRunes 或作者全部作品；可從有興趣的 Feature 進入，再逐步展開更多脈絡、治理與歷史。
LOC1–8 僅可保留為歷史識別與來源 lineage；不得再作 Current registry 檔名、Current ownership 或 authority。
Scope 保有資料與權威；Feature 可跨 Scope 重用但不取得所有權。
LOC Governance 可總覽全部並提供跨 Scope 歷史查詢；LunaRunes 的歸 LunaRunes Governance；作者與政德風的歸 lo3rwang Governance。
歷史原始紀錄保留；後來的解釋可 version / supersede，但不得靜默回寫過去。
不同意見與 competing interpretation 可以並存；異議本身不是錯誤。
AI 推論、semantic similarity、Generated data、Search、RAG 與 UI View 不得自動升格為 Canon。
LOC 對觀點保持中立，但對 authority、rights、privacy、permission、responsibility boundary 有明確治理。
systems.rune_group_rule: Do not duplicate or redefine Current LunaRunes group names here. Consumers must read data/json/core/runes66groups.json. Historical aliases such as 定序 may appear only in provenance records.

ow3gs.rule: 兩個因果模組綜合；11 抽為 OW3gs 特化格式。
ow3gs.naming_provenance: OW3gs 名稱早於『政德』作者名，因此不加政德前綴；lo3rwang 亦避免縮寫為 LOW。
